Welcome to Rystad Gaard!

In the modern apartment in the barn, you will find everything you need for a pleasant stay. Surrounded by some of the nicest nature Lofoten has to offer, you can really find tranquility in the countryside. 

The area offers great nature experiences all year round: mountain hikes, ski trips or just quiet relaxation in beautiful northern Norwegian nature with the midnight sun in the summer and northern lights in the winter.

Guest access
The guests have access to the whole apartment as well as the hiking areas that belong to the farm.

We drove from EVE Airport to the house and arrived at 11 PM. Host Halvor had thoughtfully turned on the lights and air‑conditioning ahead of our arrival. The house is spacious, immaculately clean and wonderfully cozy. We stayed 3 nights here and after long days out exploring, we always returned to a comfortable space for a good rest😃

We are absolutely delighted to have found Halvor’s place. Halvor is an excellent host; he gave us plenty of tips and was always quickly available when we needed him. The accommodation and the surrounding area were a dream! It was spotlessly clean, we felt completely at ease, and the absolute highlight was the 20-minute hike to the mountain lake located right on the property. The location is off the beaten path, offering total relaxation on an island that is otherwise very touristy. We hope to come back one day!
